title: Request purifier rewrites numeric fields before validation: "1\^@2" becomes 12 (incl. permission_id)

labels.name: php
labels.description: Pull requests that update php code

body:
Found while characterising numeric request fields for #892 (PR #945), 2026-10-13. Evidence is the characterisation test's expected table in `tests/Pgsql/NumericStringAcceptanceTest.php` on PR #945's branch. Reproduced through the API by the fixer; not yet independently validated.

`GetParsedAndFilteredRequestBody` passes request strings through HTMLPurifier before any field validation. The purifier rewrites values in ways that change what a numeric field means:

- `"1\^@2"` (a NUL between digits) is stored as **12**. On `POST /api/users/{userId}/permissions`, `permission_id: "1\^@2"` **grants permission 12**, not the permission the caller appeared to name. An audit or reviewer reading the request sees "1…2".
- `"2"` is read as **2** (entities are decoded).
- A trailing control character is dropped.

The fields are amounts, prices and ids across the stock, shopping-list and user-permission routes. The full list is in PR #945's table.

## Why this matters

Validation runs on a value different from the one the client sent. A field-level guard therefore cannot reason about the client's input. For permission writes, the effect is a grant of a different permission than the one requested. `USERS_EDIT` and `ADMIN` are needed to call the route, and ADR-0014's subset rule still applies to the purified id, so this is not a privilege escalation beyond what the caller could grant directly. It is still an integrity defect in an authorization write.

## Done when

- [ ] A decision on the rule. One option: numeric and id fields are validated on the raw JSON value and never purified. Another: any request whose purified value differs from its raw value for such a field is refused with 400.
- [ ] Regression tests for NUL, entities and control characters on `permission_id`, an amount and a price.

Related: #892, #945, ADR-0014, the S29 rich-text purifier work (plan 21).
